usedFor: Teams track parcels in AfterShip, using “Create Tracking” to add a shipment and “Mark Tracking as Completed” to close it.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Tracking” in AfterShip
bestTemplate.why: It starts tracking a shipment with its courier, so every later step has a shipment to follow.

watchOut: “Delete Tracking” in AfterShip removes a tracking by its tracking ID, so check the ID before it runs.
